 with ledger_path.open("a") as ledger: ledger.write(json.dumps(entry)+"\n")

def execute(argv, phase, cwd=root, output_path=None):
 argv=[str(value) for value in argv]
 if output_path:
  with output_path.open("w") as stream:
   completed=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=cwd,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  stdout=""
 else:
  completed=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True)
  stdout=completed.stdout
 entry={"event":"tree_control_command","control":name,"phase":phase,"candidate_head":expected_head,
  "argv":argv,"cwd":str(cwd),"exit_code":completed.returncode}
 if output_path: entry["output_path"]=str(output_path)
 elif stdout or completed.stderr: entry.update(stdout=stdout,stderr=completed.stderr)
 report["commands"].append(entry); receipt(entry)
 return completed.returncode,stdout

def require_zero(argv, phase, cwd=root):
 code,stdout=execute(argv,phase,cwd)
 if code: raise RuntimeError(f"{phase} exited {code}")
 return stdout

try:
 report["observed_head"]=require_zero(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],"initial_head").strip()

 require_zero(["git","diff","--quiet",expected_head,"--","spa/src/core/fileTree.js"],"initial_owned_source_clean")
 text=source.read_text()

 if mutant.read_text()!=text.replace(old,new): raise RuntimeError("Prepared mutant does not match candidate")
 report["mutant_sha256"]=hashlib.sha256(mutant.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 require_zero(["cp",source,copy],"save_copy")
 saved=True
 require_zero(["cmp",source,copy],"verify_saved_copy")

 require_zero(["touch",source],"touch_mutant")
 command=["nice","-n","10","env","CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8","TMPDIR="+str(scratch),

 report["command"]=command

  for failure in expected_failures}
 if report["exit_code"]!=1: raise RuntimeError("Expected actual Vitest exit1")
 if not all(report["expected_failure_names_present"].values()): raise RuntimeError("Missing expected behavioral failing name")
except BaseException as error:
 report["runner_error"]=repr(error)
finally:
 if saved:
  report["restore_cp_exit_code"],_=execute(["cp",copy,source],"restore_copy")
  report["restore_touch_exit_code"],_=execute(["touch",source],"touch_restored_source")
  report["cmp_exit_code"],_=execute(["cmp",copy,source],"verify_restore_cmp")
  report["restored_sha256"]=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  code,head=execute(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],"final_head")
  report["final_head"]=head.strip()
  report["final_owned_source_exit_code"],_=execute(["git","diff","--quiet",expected_head,"--","spa/src/core/fileTree.js"],"final_owned_source_clean")
  report["restoration_verified"]=all(report.get(field)==0 for field in (
   "restore_cp_exit_code","restore_touch_exit_code","cmp_exit_code","final_owned_source_exit_code")) \
   and code==0 and report["final_head"]==expected_head and report["restored_sha256"]==expected_source_sha256
 else: report["restoration_verified"]=False
 result.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
 receipt({"event":"tree_control_result",**report})
print(json.dumps(report))
sys.exit(1 if report.get("exit_code")==1 and report["restoration_verified"] and "runner_error" not in report else 2)
